questions.stem: A car travels at a constant speed of 30 m/s in a straight line. What can you conclude about the forces acting on it?

options.text: There is a net forward force
There are no forces acting on the car
The resultant force is zero (forces are balanced)
The driving force is greater than friction

questions.explanation: Since the car is moving at constant velocity (not accelerating), by Newton's First Law the resultant force must be zero. The driving force exactly balances the resistive forces (friction and drag).
